In mathematics, '''Heckman–Opdam polynomials''' (sometimes called '''Jacobi polynomials''') ''P''<sub>λ</sub>(''k'') are orthogonal polynomials in several variables associated to root systems. They were introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Heckman|last2=Opdam|year=1987}}.

They generalize [[Jack polynomial]]s when the root system is of type ''A'', and are limits of [[Macdonald polynomials]] ''P''<sub>λ</sub>(''q'',&nbsp;''t'') as ''q'' tends to 1 and (1&nbsp;&minus;&nbsp;''t'')/(1&nbsp;&minus;&nbsp;''q'') tends to&nbsp;''k''.
Main properties of the Heckman–Opdam polynomials have been detailed by Siddhartha Sahi <ref>A new formula for weight multiplicities and characters, Theorem 1.3. about Heckman–Opdam polynomials,  Siddhartha Sahi {{ArXiv|math/9802127}}</ref>
